title: Spectator health port allocation can race on startup
description:
Golden tests allocate the observer health port in Python with `find_available_port("localhost", 20000)` and then pass that value to `ObserverMain` via `-Dxmage.observer.healthPort`. This is a time-of-check/time-of-use race: another process can bind the chosen port before the observer health server starts.

Observed failure while regenerating `multi_amount_combat` on March 14, 2026:
- `tests/conftest.py` selected port `20000`
- spectator startup spent ~58s waiting for health
- `tmp/golden-spectator/spectator.log` showed `Failed to start observer health server on port 20000` with `java.net.BindException: Address already in use`
- pytest then failed in `_wait_for_health()` with `http.client.RemoteDisconnected`

This makes golden tests intermittently fail during session-scoped spectator startup even when the actual game logic is fine.

Expected behavior: spectator startup should reserve or retry the health port robustly instead of depending on a racy pre-check in Python.
